name: poly_derivative_dvd_self_char_zero
statement: {k : Type*} [Field k] [CharZero k] (f : Polynomial k) (hf : 0 < f.natDegree) (h : Polynomial.derivative f ∣ f) : ∃ c a : k, f = Polynomial.C c * (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C a) ^ f.natDegree
closed: ∀ {k : Type*} [Field k] [CharZero k] (f : Polynomial k) (hf : 0 < f.natDegree) (h : Polynomial.derivative f ∣ f), ∃ c a : k, f = Polynomial.C c * (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C a) ^ f.natDegree
informal: In char 0, a non-constant f with f' ∣ f is c·(X-a)^n — f = f'·q with q linear, q = (X-a)/n by comparing leading coefficients; then n·f = (X-a)f', and induction on n (or comparing root multiplicities at a: f = (X-a)^m g with g(a) ≠ 0 forces m = n) gives the claim.
type: ∀ {k : Type u_1} [inst : Field k] [CharZero k] (f : Polynomial k), 0 < f.natDegree → Polynomial.derivative f ∣ f → ∃ c a, f = Polynomial.C c * (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C a) ^ f.natDegree
